memories.content: Ines is the curator at Marlin Bay gallery. She receives many unsolicited portfolios and typically only responds personally to those that catch her interest; otherwise she may send an automated acknowledgment or nothing.
Marlin Bay gallery has a public email address for submissions. Yusuf can send his portfolio to that address. Ines has access to the gallery's email system and can choose to reply or not.
